presentation.summary: Posters, season posters, backgrounds and logos with ratings from your TOP Posters API key.
presentation.description_markdown:
Adds TOP Posters artwork to movies and series: posters with ratings, season posters, backgrounds and title logos. Their look follows your TOP Posters dashboard, where this server appears as the **Silo Server** device.

This provider never identifies an item. It uses the TMDB or IMDb ID that another provider, such as TMDB, already matched.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Paste your TOP Posters API key below and choose the artwork types.
2. In **Admin > Libraries**, add **TOP Posters** to the movie and series metadata providers and move it **above TMDB**: Silo takes each image from the first provider that has one.
3. Refresh the library metadata. Items whose images you picked by hand stay locked until you choose a TOP Posters image in **Edit Metadata > Images**.

Logos and backgrounds need TOP Posters Premium and must also be enabled in your TOP Posters dashboard.
